title: Network meta-analysis (frequentist, random effects)
summary: Combined direct and indirect estimates for three treatments from two-arm trials, with a common between-trial variance and the between-design inconsistency Q.
pinned_defaults: netmeta's model (Rucker 2012) for two-arm trials, written out in both languages: weighted least squares on the trial contrasts over the basic parameters (B and C against the reference A); tau^2 = (Q - df) / (tr(W) - tr(W X (X'WX)^-1 X'W)) floored at 0 (generalised DerSimonian-Laird); random effects; the common-effect estimates, Q and its between-design (inconsistency) component.

Both reproduce netmeta::netmeta(sm = 'OR', method.tau = 'DL', reference.group = 'A') to 1e-10 on this fixture, checked with netmeta 3.7.0. netmeta is not called in CI: it depends on igraph, whose compiled library needs a system library the CI runner lacks. With multi-arm trials use netmeta, which handles their correlation.
_assumptions: Consistency (direct and indirect evidence agree) and transitivity (trials similar in effect modifiers). Report the inconsistency test; rankings (P-scores, SUCRA) come after effects with intervals.
